religion_note: PRRI, Census of American Religion: County-Level Data on Religious Identity and Diversity (American Values Atlas), published as the 2023 PRRI Census of American Religion; the released table's own year column reads 2024, the year shown here. Self-reported religious identity among adults, modelled to county level from a national random sample of 40,000 adults on Ipsos's KnowledgePanel (national margin of error +/-0.7 points); these are small-area estimates, not an enumeration, and they describe adults rather than all residents. Replaces the 2020 U.S. Religion Census adherent counts this county carried; those counts reach about 48.6% of the population nationally (27% to 76% by state) and cannot distinguish the unaffiliated from the unreported. PRRI's categories cross race with religion; the five Protestant and three Catholic categories are summed into Protestantism and Catholicism and the racial detail is dropped rather than filed under religion, so this file cannot be used to ask about religion by race. Unitarian Universalists are counted in 'Other religions'.
